l4_steps.name: Retrieve NOTAMs from FAA/ICAO AFTN network
l4_steps.input: Continuous AFTN/CIDIN feed from FAA NOTAM System (FNS) and ICAO NOF
l4_steps.output: Raw NOTAM messages ingested into NOTAM processing queue
l4_steps.kpi: NOTAM ingestion latency ≤5 min from issuance to system receipt
l4_steps.pain_point: FAA NOTAM System outages (e.g., Jan 2023 FAA NOTAM system failure grounding 10,000 flights) can break AFTN feed with no automatic failover to backup source

l4_steps.name: Parse and classify NOTAMs by type and location
l4_steps.input: Raw NOTAM text strings from AFTN queue
l4_steps.output: Classified NOTAM records: type (N, C, R, Q-code), ICAO location, validity window
l4_steps.pain_point: Legacy free-text NOTAM format (pre-ICAO Digital NOTAM standard) leads to high parse error rates, especially for non-standard national formats from international destinations

l4_steps.name: Validate NOTAM format completeness and decode Q-line
l4_steps.input: Parsed NOTAM record with Q-line fields (FIR, code, purpose, scope, coordinates)
l4_steps.output: Validated NOTAM record or rejection flag with error description
l4_steps.kpi: Validation cycle time ≤30 sec per NOTAM batch
l4_steps.pain_point: Incomplete Q-lines from some national NOTAM offices require manual correction, creating dispatcher workload spikes during high-NOTAM-volume periods (e.g., airshow TFRs, VIP TFRs)

l4_steps.name: Filter NOTAMs against active airline route network
l4_steps.input: Validated NOTAM records; active city-pair route list from Amadeus SkyWORKS
l4_steps.output: Route-relevant NOTAM subset filtered by departure, destination, alternate, and enroute FIRs
l4_steps.kpi: False-positive NOTAM rate ≤10% (irrelevant NOTAMs passed to dispatchers)
l4_steps.pain_point: Overly broad geographic filters result in NOTAM overload — dispatchers report reviewing 200–400 NOTAMs per long-haul release; filter tuning is manual and not route-aware

l4_steps.name: Assign operational severity level to filtered NOTAMs
l4_steps.input: Route-relevant NOTAM subset with Q-code purpose/scope fields
l4_steps.output: Severity-ranked NOTAM list: Critical (runway/navaid closed), Significant (degraded service), Advisory (FYI)
l4_steps.kpi: Critical NOTAM identification accuracy ≥99.9%; missed critical NOTAM rate = 0
l4_steps.pain_point: Automated severity scoring relies on Q-code purpose field, which is inconsistently applied by international NOTAM offices — human review remains mandatory for all Critical-category items

l4_steps.name: Determine if NOTAM affects operational route or airport
l4_steps.input: Severity-ranked NOTAM list; scheduled flight manifest for next 24 hours
l4_steps.output: Action decision: Escalate for impact assessment (Critical/Significant) or Archive (Advisory only)
l4_steps.kpi: Escalation decision cycle time ≤10 min per NOTAM batch review
l4_steps.pain_point: Dispatchers managing 30–50 concurrent flights face decision fatigue during high-tempo NOTAM periods; no AI-assisted triage available in current Jeppesen version

l4_steps.name: Analyse runway and navaid availability constraints
l4_steps.input: Critical/Significant NOTAMs for departure, destination, and alternate airports
l4_steps.output: Runway availability matrix; navaid serviceability status per airport
l4_steps.kpi: Constraint analysis completion ≥2 hours before STD for all affected flights
l4_steps.pain_point: Runway NOTAM status may conflict with airport ATIS/D-ATIS if NOTAM is issued but not yet reflected in automated terminal information — dispatchers must cross-check both sources manually

l4_steps.name: Review AIP amendments and SUPs for permanent changes
l4_steps.input: Current AIP amendments (AIRACs) and AIP Supplements for affected airports
l4_steps.output: List of permanent procedural changes affecting approach minima, SIDs/STARs, or obstacle clearance
l4_steps.kpi: AIRAC cycle review completion within 24 hours of effective date; 0 missed effective-date changes
l4_steps.pain_point: AIRAC cycle updates (every 28 days) require coordinated updates across FliteDeck, NAVBLUE, and FMS navigation databases — misaligned update windows create temporary procedure inconsistencies

l4_steps.name: Assess alternate airport availability under active NOTAMs
l4_steps.input: Alternate airport candidates from flight plan; NOTAMs affecting alternate runways and navaids
l4_steps.output: Approved alternate airport list with NOTAM-qualified minima adjustments
l4_steps.kpi: Alternate qualification cycle time ≤20 min per flight; 0 releases with non-qualified alternates
l4_steps.pain_point: Destination alternate requirements under FAR 91.169 / ICAO Annex 2 require dispatcher to verify alternate ILS/RNAV availability — NOTAM-driven navaid outages at alternates frequently require last-minute alternate substitution

l4_steps.name: Determine if flight plan modification is required
l4_steps.input: Runway/navaid constraints; AIP changes; alternate qualification results
l4_steps.output: Modification flag: re-route, alternate change, fuel uplift revision, or no change required
l4_steps.kpi: Flight plan modification decision issued ≥90 min before STD
l4_steps.pain_point: Late-issued TFRs and runway NOTAMs within 90 minutes of departure compress decision windows and may force gate-hold or airborne re-route, increasing ATC workload and crew duty time

l4_steps.name: Compile route-specific NOTAM briefing package
l4_steps.input: Filtered, severity-ranked NOTAMs for departure, enroute FIRs, destination, and alternates
l4_steps.output: Structured NOTAM briefing document: categorised, sorted by phase of flight, valid times highlighted
l4_steps.kpi: Briefing package generation time ≤15 min; package length ≤ 10 pages for domestic, ≤25 pages for international
l4_steps.pain_point: Unfiltered NOTAM packages can exceed 80 pages on busy international routes — crews report difficulty identifying safety-critical items; no regulatory standard mandates package length limits

l4_steps.name: Push NOTAM package to crew EFB pre-departure folder
l4_steps.input: Compiled NOTAM briefing package; flight number and tail assignment from Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: NOTAM package loaded on crew EFB with push notification to assigned Captain and First Officer
l4_steps.kpi: EFB delivery confirmation ≥60 min before STD; push failure rate <1%
l4_steps.pain_point: EFB connectivity at gates with poor Wi-Fi infrastructure can delay package delivery; crews boarding late international flights may not receive updates if EFB sync occurs only at logon

l4_steps.name: Confirm critical NOTAM acknowledgement by flight crew
l4_steps.input: NOTAM briefing package with Critical items flagged; crew electronic signature workflow
l4_steps.output: Signed acknowledgement record with timestamp; unacknowledged items escalated to dispatcher
l4_steps.kpi: Crew acknowledgement completion ≥30 min before STD for all Critical NOTAMs; 0 departures without acknowledgement
l4_steps.pain_point: Electronic acknowledgement workflow is checkbox-based — does not confirm comprehension; NTSB has cited NOTAM awareness failures in several runway incursion incidents where crews signed off on packages without reviewing Critical items

l4_steps.name: Validate flight plan route against active airspace NOTAMs
l4_steps.input: Filed flight plan route (ICAO format); active airspace restriction NOTAMs (TFRs, restricted areas, ADIZs)
l4_steps.output: Route compliance report: conflicts flagged with NOTAM reference and lateral/vertical extent
l4_steps.kpi: Route validation cycle time ≤5 min; 0 flight plans released with unresolved airspace conflicts
l4_steps.pain_point: Dynamic TFR activations (security, VIP movements, wildfire operations) may occur after initial flight plan filing — NAVBLUE automated airspace conflict check must be re-run within 30 min of departure

l4_steps.name: Update alternate airport selections per NOTAM constraints
l4_steps.input: NOTAM-qualified alternate list from Step 3.3; current fuel load plan
l4_steps.output: Revised alternate airports filed in ICAO flight plan; fuel adjustment order if additional alternate required
l4_steps.kpi: Alternate update reflected in ATC-filed flight plan ≥45 min before STD
l4_steps.pain_point: Adding a more distant alternate due to NOTAM-driven disqualification increases fuel burn — late alternate changes may require fuel truck return to gate, impacting on-time departure (D0) performance

l4_steps.name: Confirm flight plan is fully NOTAM-compliant before release
l4_steps.input: Final flight plan with route, alternates, and fuel load; complete active NOTAM set
l4_steps.output: Dispatcher release signature and Aircraft Dispatcher's Release (ADR) document compliant with FAR 121.593
l4_steps.kpi: 0 dispatcher releases with open unresolved Critical NOTAMs; release issued ≥30 min before STD
l4_steps.pain_point: FAR 121.593 requires joint Captain/Dispatcher release — if Captain refuses to sign due to NOTAM concern, operational control dispute escalation process is time-consuming and not well-documented in most airline SOPs

l4_steps.name: Monitor NOTAM updates for airborne flights via ACARS
l4_steps.input: Real-time NOTAM feed from Honeywell GoDirect; active airborne flight list
l4_steps.output: ACARS uplink messages to affected crews with new or amended NOTAM details
l4_steps.kpi: In-flight NOTAM update transmission latency ≤10 min from issuance; crew acknowledgement receipt ≥95%
l4_steps.pain_point: ACARS coverage gaps over oceanic tracks and remote domestic segments (e.g., Alaska corridors) can delay critical NOTAM uplinks; satellite ACARS costs constrain message frequency on some routes

l4_steps.name: Archive expired NOTAMs and update operational log
l4_steps.input: Expired and cancelled NOTAM records; flight completion confirmations from Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Archived NOTAM audit trail; updated operational log with NOTAM-driven delay and re-route codes
l4_steps.kpi: NOTAM archive completeness 100%; delay attribution accuracy ≥98% for NOTAM-caused events
l4_steps.pain_point: NOTAM-driven delays are frequently miscoded in delay tracking systems (e.g., coded as 'weather' rather than 'NOTAM/airspace') — corrupting operational performance data used for ATC slot planning and DOT reporting
